primary_sources.title: Orevkov, The fundamental group of the complement of a plane algebraic curve
primary_sources.used_statement: Audit only: PDF2 Added in2003 withdraws the claimed general Jacobian reduction. That claim is not a premise. No inference that every polynomially parametrized curve has abelian Orevkov invariant.

exact_primary_boundary: All topology is imported or proved in writing. No universal nodal/complement/positivity claim; no withdrawn Jacobian reduction; no proof from finite controls.
